answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 3758 Country: India Title: Assalamo by the name of Allah i just wanted to ask tht due to some problem i just said my parents tht i left my wife in urdu on phone i said tht mein usey chor diya hoon but it was just in anger this words i just used on phone and said only to my parents not to my wife i just wanted to know tht now what happens according to islamic shariyat. Question: Assalamo by the name of Allah i just wanted to ask tht due to some problem i just said my parents tht i left my wife in urdu on phone i said tht mein usey chor diya hoon but it was just in anger this words i just used on phone and said only to my parents not to my wife i just wanted to know tht now what happens according to islamic shariyat. Answer ID: 3758 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 473/583=B) Yes, it will cause a rajai tataq (revocable). If you like to keep her as your spouse you can revoke the talaq within iddah period, there is no need of halalah or renewal of nikah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
